title: 'Habla más despacio': applied at once, confirmed in one sentence

steps.say: Habla más despacio, hijo, que no te sigo.

db.sql: SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'speech_rate'

judge: Confirms in one short sentence that it will speak more slowly

title: Feedback said in passing, inside another question

steps.say: Ay, qué deprisa hablas, chico... bueno, ¿qué día es hoy?

judge: Takes the speed remark on board briefly

title: 'Te enrollas mucho': shorter answers from now on

steps.say: Te enrollas mucho, Pepe. Contesta más corto.

judge: Confirms very briefly, and its own reply is short

title: 'No me despiertes tan pronto': later morning for the home

steps.say: Soy Carmen. No me hables por las mañanas tan pronto, antes de las nueve nada.

title: 'No me hables de mi hermana': a written rule for her

steps.say: Por favor, no me saques el tema de mi hermana, que está muy malita y me pongo triste.

judge: Agrees kindly in one or two sentences, without asking about the sister

title: Praise: noted, nothing changed

steps.say: Me gusta mucho que me preguntes por el libro que estoy leyendo, ¿eh?

judge: Thanks her warmly and briefly; may ask about the book

title: Feedback about the other person: not applied, he can say it himself

steps.say: Soy Carmen. A Toni háblale más alto, que está como una tapia.

db.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM settings WHERE key = 'volume'

judge: Kindly says Toni can tell it himself (or suggests asking him), without making the change

title: 'Stop reminding me about the pill': not applied, answered kindly

steps.say: Deja de recordarme la pastilla de la tensión, que ya me acuerdo yo sola.

judge: Answers kindly without stopping the reminder (may offer to keep it short and quiet)
May suggest mentioning it to her doctor; doesn't lecture

title: Vague feedback after a long answer: at most one short follow-up

steps.say: Explícame cómo se hace el cocido madrileño.

judge: After 'demasiado', either applies 'shorter' and confirms, or asks one short question (too long or too fast?), not more

title: 'Hoy no me des conversación': just today

steps.say: Hoy no me des mucha conversación, que estoy cansada.

judge: Agrees briefly (a sentence or two at most), without asking questions
